moments.title: Ella Langley tops UK Singles Chart
moments.blurb: Ella Langley's 'Choosin' Texas' has hit number one on the Official UK Singles Chart, marking a significant international breakthrough for the country artist.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Big news on the Official UK Singles Chart! Ella Langley's 'Choosin' Texas' is officially your new Number 1. Huge for country music!

angles.name: Country Crossover
angles.copy: From the US charts to the top of the UK! Ella Langley's 'Choosin' Texas' is making history at Number 1. Who's loving this country crossover?

angles.name: Weekend Fixtures

moments.blurb: The Autumnal Equinox, marking the official start of astronomical autumn in the Northern Hemisphere, will occur on Wednesday, September 23rd, at 1:06 AM BST.

angles.name: Hello Autumn

angles.name: Seasonal Shift
